statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The symptoms are intermittent and require continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I34.0, R55
The denial reason is CO-18 (duplicate billing)
